parameters.query:
SELECT id, name, project_type, location_province, location_city,
       property_type, property_area_m2, budget_target,
       (metadata->>'edad_edificio')::int AS edad_edificio,
       (metadata->>'numero_viviendas')::int AS num_viviendas,
       metadata->>'usuario_movilidad_reducida' AS usuario_mr
FROM projects WHERE id = $1::uuid LIMIT 1

SELECT id, summary, rooms_affected, constraints
FROM briefings
WHERE project_id = $1::uuid AND status = 'approved'
ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, title, intervention_logic, rooms_layout
FROM design_options
WHERE project_id = $1::uuid AND is_selected = true
ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO agent_executions (project_id, agent_name, status, started_at, input, metadata)
VALUES ($1::uuid, 'agent_accessibility', 'running', now(), $2::jsonb, $3::jsonb) RETURNING id

INSERT INTO accessibility_audits (project_id, applies_to_project, overall_compliance, compliance_issues, recommendations, commercial_argumentation)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::boolean, $3::text, $4::jsonb, $5::jsonb, $6::text)
RETURNING id

UPDATE agent_executions
SET status = 'completed', finished_at = now(),
    output = $2::jsonb,
    metadata = COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb) || $3::jsonb
WHERE id = $1::uuid
